title: 第538章 暗中监视的羊
slug: 规则怪谈从诡异哆啦a梦开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“老公，这个你拿着。”

红太狼将瓶子轻轻举起。

看着里面的红色液体，林远声音有些不悦：

“老婆，你身体都这么虚弱了，还给我准备血？！”

见林远有些生气，红太狼冷哼一声。

“灰太狼，别得寸进尺。”

“老娘给你，你就拿着！”

“你要是死在外面了，我是不是又得穿越9527次才能见到你？”

“还是说，你怀念被我用平底锅揍完之后，才乖乖听话。”

红太狼绘声绘色，哪里像个失血过多的狼？

林远为了维持原作的人设，也不打算和红太狼过多争执。

虽然灰太狼是真爱平底锅，但他也是真怕疼。

“老婆都这么虚弱了，我怎么还能让老婆费力气揍我呢？”

“我这就拿着老婆给的血！！！”

林远的手速那叫一个快。

红太狼眨了一下眼，林远就拿到了装满血的瓶子。

“哼，省着点用。”

“我的血可不像懒羊羊的薯片能复活你，但无论你是内伤还是外伤，喝下一口后绝对见效。”

“不过你也别作死，受特别严重的伤，就需要慢慢滋养了。”

红太狼告诫完林远后，双眼一眯，躺在床上背对了林远。

林远点了点头，看着大概有500毫升的血，声音哽咽道：

“老婆，谢谢你！”

“我一定会搞清楚小灰灰复活的方法！”

“我们一定会重聚的！”

说完这话，林远头也不回地离开了。

躺在床上的红太狼，双眼已经染湿了枕头。

而他们不知道的是，在狼堡的某处，一台相机，结束了拍摄。

此时那道影子快速收起相机，悄无声息的离开了。

林远洗完碗，就赶了过来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Husband, take this."

Red Wolf gently lifted the bottle.

Looking at the red liquid inside, Lin Yuan's voice was a little unhappy:

"Honey, you are so weak, why are you preparing blood for me?!"

Seeing that Lin Yuan was a little angry, Red Wolf snorted coldly.

"Big Big Wolf, don't push yourself too far."

"I'll give it to you, just take it!"

"If you die outside, will I have to travel through time 9527 times before I can see you?"

"Or do you miss being beaten with a frying pan by me before you obey me?"

The red wolf is lifelike, but how does it look like a wolf that has lost too much blood?

In order to maintain the character of the original work, Lin Yuan did not intend to argue too much with Red Wolf.

Although Big Big Wolf really loves pans, he is also really afraid of pain.

"My wife is so weak, how can I still let my wife have the energy to beat me?"

"I'll just take the blood my wife gave me!!!"

Lin Yuan's hand speed was extremely fast.

Red Wolf blinked, and Lin Yuan got the bottle filled with blood.

"Hmph, save it."

"My blood is not like Lazy Sheep's potato chips that can revive you, but whether you have internal or external injuries, it will definitely be effective after one sip."

"But don't seek death. If you are seriously injured, you need to nourish it slowly."

After Red Wolf warned Lin Yuan, he narrowed his eyes and lay on the bed with his back to Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan nodded, looked at about 500 ml of blood, and said with a choked voice:

"Honey, thank you!"

"I will definitely figure out how to revive Little Huihui!"

"We will definitely reunite!"

After saying this, Lin Yuan left without looking back.

Red Wolf was lying on the bed, his eyes wet the pillow.

What they didn't know was that somewhere in Wolfsburg, a camera ended the shooting.

At this time, the shadow quickly put away the camera and left quietly.

Lin Yuan rushed over after washing the dishes.
